name: Orange-spotted grouper
desc: A large reef predator of the region. It eats fish, crustaceans and cephalopods, and is a target of fishing in the bay.
about: The orange-spotted grouper, also known as the brown-spotted rockcod, estuary cod, estuary rockcod, goldspotted rockcod, greasy cod, North-west groper, orange spotted cod or blue-and-yellow grouper,…
